edges.rationale: Random byte generation carries no external authority in the package threat model.
The initial profile has no positive target/signal selector and refuses package signaling.

entries.resourceSemantics: Typed fetch endpoint with scheme, canonical host kind, materialized port, direct route, peer classes, selected candidate, and verified peer.
entries.rationale: The current check covers only a lowercased requested hostname; WP6 must add staged peer, redirect, reconnect, and route checks.

entries.resourceSemantics: Typed raw or bidirectional endpoint with transport, canonical host, exact or bounded port, route, peer classes, and verified peer.
entries.rationale: TCP, UDP, WebSocket, and similar transports remain separate from sealed fetch authority.

entries.resourceSemantics: Typed internet or Unix bind resource with transport, interface/address class, and exact, bounded, or explicit ephemeral port.
entries.rationale: The current host:port string does not capture dual-stack, interface, Unix path, accepted-peer, or cleanup semantics.

entries.resourceSemantics: Unix-domain operations emit typed connect or listen plus applicable fs:list and fs:write effects for pathname sockets.
entries.rationale: The legacy token conflates outbound and inbound authority and lowercases case-sensitive Unix paths.

entries.resourceSemantics: Logical-root path-exact or path-tree selector; the occurrence binds follow mode and the retained or verified object identity actually read.
entries.rationale: The existing symlink normalization is retained only as input to checked-object execution, not as a check-then-reopen guarantee.

entries.resourceSemantics: Logical-root exact/tree path with verified parent and target identities at each mutation stage.
entries.rationale: Multi-path and metadata operations must authorize all list/write effects before mutation.

entries.resourceSemantics: Exact/tree metadata and existence-disclosure authority, independent of byte reads.
entries.rationale: The bit is currently inert because stat, readdir, and existence disclosure are folded into fs:read.

entries.resourceSemantics: Exact/tree live observation with owner, source, generation, and delivery rechecks.
entries.rationale: The bit is currently inert and polling watch behavior is folded into fs:read.

entries.resourceSemantics: One exact environment name and effect-owner namespace; enumeration emits one effect per name.
entries.rationale: The canonical format forbids the current positive * name and separates broker base values from principal overlays.

entries.resourceSemantics: Terminal static-only executable identity including logical name, retained path/object, content digest, and interpreter; child env, stdio, cwd, and filesystem effects are conjunctive.
entries.rationale: The current resource-less grant covers every executable and launch option and cannot survive into canonical policy.

entries.resourceSemantics: Future semantics require an explicit target class and signal set, with inspector activation conjunctively checked where applicable.
entries.rationale: Arbitrary signaling is shared-process mutation and remains deny-only in the initial profile.

entries.resourceSemantics: Shared process current-directory mutation has no positive selector in the initial profile.
entries.rationale: Keep closed unless cwd is virtualized or scoped without changing other principals' resolution.

entries.resourceSemantics: One typed location action with explicit foreground/background usage and coarse/precise precision.
entries.rationale: The broad legacy prefix must not silently imply every present or future location qualifier.

entries.resourceSemantics: Typed device-location selector with usage foreground and explicit precision.
entries.rationale: Android current-location calls already check this legacy spelling; canonical policy uses the typed base action.

entries.resourceSemantics: Reserved typed device-location selector with usage background.
entries.rationale: No background-authority surface or enforcing gate exists, so target cells must prove a future implementation before authoring it.

entries.resourceSemantics: Typed device-location selector with precision precise; Android high-accuracy acquisition also requires foreground usage.
entries.rationale: Precision is a resource predicate, not a third colon-delimited action segment.

entries.resourceSemantics: Coarse precision is an attenuation/status value on device:location.
entries.rationale: Reduced accuracy grants no independent authority and must not become a separate positive action.

entries.resourceSemantics: Typed facing/device selection and photo/video operation class, with broker generation and resolved device identity in occurrences.
entries.rationale: The current Android base gate ignores public front/back/external distinctions; target cells remain unsupported until the native boundary preserves them.

entries.resourceSemantics: Typed audio capture and optional device identity.
entries.rationale: Capture APIs exist but no complete Ibex native effect gate protects actual recording yet.

entries.resourceSemantics: No aggregate positive action; future read and write resources must be explicit.
entries.rationale: The legacy base string silently implies read, write, and limited status.

entries.resourceSemantics: Future typed library or user-selected collection read resource.
entries.rationale: No enforced photo-library read surface exists.

entries.resourceSemantics: Future typed library or album mutation resource.
entries.rationale: No enforced photo-library write surface exists.

entries.resourceSemantics: OS selection/status constraint on a future photo resource.
entries.rationale: Limited selection is attenuation state, not independent authority.

entries.resourceSemantics: No aggregate positive action; future read/write actions require account and contact-set resources.
entries.rationale: The broad base token would silently accrue future contact actions.

entries.resourceSemantics: Future typed account/contact-set read resource.
entries.rationale: No enforced contact read surface exists.

entries.resourceSemantics: Future typed account/contact mutation resource.
entries.rationale: No enforced contact write surface exists.

entries.resourceSemantics: No aggregate sensor authority; future actions require sensor kind and sampling semantics.
entries.rationale: No enforced generic sensor surface exists.

entries.resourceSemantics: Future typed motion sensor kind, sampling rate, and lifetime resource.
entries.rationale: No enforced motion surface exists.

entries.resourceSemantics: No aggregate Bluetooth positive action; scan, connect, and advertise require different resources.
entries.rationale: The broad base token silently implies all Bluetooth sub-actions.

entries.resourceSemantics: Future typed scan filter and duration resource.
entries.rationale: No enforced Bluetooth scan surface exists.

entries.resourceSemantics: Future typed peer, service, and characteristic resource.
entries.rationale: No enforced Bluetooth connect surface exists.

entries.resourceSemantics: Future typed service and bounded payload resource.
entries.rationale: No enforced Bluetooth advertise surface exists.

entries.resourceSemantics: Future brokered assertion purpose and relying-party resource.
entries.rationale: No enforced biometric assertion surface exists.

entries.resourceSemantics: No aggregate credential authority; future read and write resources must be explicit.
entries.rationale: The base token silently implies credential read and write.

entries.resourceSemantics: Future typed credential store, item class, and operation resource.
entries.rationale: No enforced credential read surface exists.

entries.resourceSemantics: Future typed credential store, item class, and mutation resource.
entries.rationale: No enforced credential write surface exists.

entries.resourceSemantics: Future typed channel and delivery operation resource.
entries.rationale: Only JS metadata claims this capability; no enforcing notification surface was found.

entries.resourceSemantics: No aggregate calendar authority; future read/write resources must be explicit.
entries.rationale: The broad base token silently implies calendar read and write.

entries.resourceSemantics: Future typed account and calendar read scope.
entries.rationale: No enforced calendar read surface exists.

entries.resourceSemantics: Future typed account and calendar mutation scope.
entries.rationale: No enforced calendar write surface exists.

entries.resourceSemantics: Future reminders vocabulary must separate read and write and type its account/list scope.
entries.rationale: The current undifferentiated bit has no enforcing surface.

entries.resourceSemantics: No aggregate health authority; future read/write resources must be explicit.
entries.rationale: The broad base token silently implies health read and write.

entries.resourceSemantics: Future typed data-class and time-range read resource.
entries.rationale: No enforced health read surface exists.

entries.resourceSemantics: Future typed data-class mutation resource.
entries.rationale: No enforced health write surface exists.

entries.resourceSemantics: Explicit read/write actions over a local principal or named shared namespace.
entries.rationale: The current token grants both read and write to an app-wide store and remains closed until native namespace isolation is proven.

entries.resourceSemantics: Explicit read/write actions over a session principal or named shared namespace.
entries.rationale: The current token grants both read and write to shared session state and remains closed until isolation is proven.

entries.resourceSemantics: Typed namespace, quota class, and persistence/eviction semantics.
entries.rationale: The current hint/boolean does not express the authority or shared storage affected.

entries.resourceSemantics: File-backed SQLite emits typed fs:list and fs:read for the checked database objects; in-memory SQLite is computation.
entries.rationale: SQLite is an API class, not distinct external authority.

entries.resourceSemantics: File-backed SQLite emits typed list/read/write effects for the main database, parent, journal, WAL, SHM, and other operated objects.
entries.rationale: The current API token plus main-path checks omit staged sidecar-object semantics and must be decomposed.

entries.resourceSemantics: Typed native system clipboard and explicit format set, with broker generation where the OS prompts.
entries.rationale: Android has a native gate; any shared in-memory fallback must be separately classified rather than assumed harmless.

entries.resourceSemantics: Typed native system clipboard and explicit format set.
entries.rationale: Write is independent from read and must not imply disclosure.

entries.resourceSemantics: Ordinary cryptographic randomness is a reasoned non-capability.
entries.rationale: The current manager always allows it before policy, so retaining a positive token would be dishonest.

entries.resourceSemantics: Pure cryptography over caller-provided or in-memory keys is computation; platform keystore access belongs to a future credential effect.
entries.rationale: The blanket JS-layer token names an API rather than external authority.

entries.resourceSemantics: Ordinary wall and monotonic clocks are reasoned non-capabilities for this threat model.
entries.rationale: The current manager always allows time:now and no enforcing surface uses the bit.

entries.resourceSemantics: High-resolution clocks remain a documented non-capability under the package-authority threat model.
entries.rationale: No enforcing surface uses the bit; side-channel mitigation belongs to the runtime profile, not positive package authority.

entries.resourceSemantics: Future ambient IPC requires an exact channel namespace and peer identity; child IPC is spawn plus owned descriptor possession.
entries.rationale: No capability check uses this bit and an unscoped ambient channel cannot be authorable.

entries.resourceSemantics: Typed absolute DNS query name, explicit record-type set, and resolver route.
entries.rationale: The current helper checks only a lowercased target; internal fetch/connect DNS neither requires nor grants standalone resolve.

cells.rationale: WP0 has not proved selected-peer, redirect, route, and lifetime semantics.
WP0 has not proved retained-object execution and staged multi-effect checks.
Package-originated signaling is refused for the initial profile.
